title: From Fractional to Set Tilings for Pairs of Lattices
summary: We generalize a theorem of Isbell asserting that every countably infinite doubly stochastic matrix has a positive generalized diagonal. As an application, we prove a support-reduction theorem for simultaneous lattice tilings. Namely, if a nonnegative measurable function bounded above by one tiles Euclidean space by translations along two full-rank lattices with integer multiplicities, then its pointwise support contains a possibly nonmeasurable set whose indicator function satisfies the same two tiling identities.
